text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It has very little astringency and goes 
down easily. I think I'll make this my 
go-to from now on...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...All the manufacturer's thoughtful 
efforts, and its true flavor too... 
completely wasted."
